name: Elemental Grasp
body:
Prerequisite: Squole

Benefit: If you are wearing light or no armor, you deal an extra 1d6 energy damage on a successful grapple attack to deal damage. The type of energy is consistent with your paraelemental subtype (ice—cold, magma—fire, ooze—acid).

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
